name: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
tagline: Leader in data center AI and high-performance computing
hero_kpi_rationale: Le revenu data center est le principal moteur de croissance d'AMD, tiré par la forte demande en puces IA et serveurs avec les EPYC 5ème génération et les GPU Instinct MI350, positionnant AMD comme challenger direct de Nvidia dans la vague de l'IA générative.

kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by processors and GPUs for data centers, primarily used in AI and cloud computing.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by AI and hyperscaler demand.
kpis.description: In 2025, the data center segment generated $16.6 billion in revenue, up 32% from $12.6 billion in 2024, driven by strong demand for 5th generation AMD EPYC processors and AMD Instinct MI350 Series GPUs.
kpis._validation: Unit corrected from 'Mds $' to 'B$'; tagline improved

kpis.name_fr: Revenu segment IA et cloud haute performance
kpis.explanation: Revenue tied to high-performance computing and AI solutions, included within data center segment, key for future growth.
kpis.signal: AMD captures AI wave through data center GPU momentum.
kpis.description: AI and HPC revenue is included in the data center segment, which reached $16.6 billion in 2025, driven by Instinct GPUs dedicated to generative AI workloads.
kpis._validation: Unit corrected from 'Mds $' to 'B$'; clarified that this is a component of data center segment not a separate revenue line

kpis.explanation: Total sales realized by AMD across all segments during the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Total net revenue reached $34.6 billion in 2025, compared to $25.8 billion in 2024, representing 34% year-over-year growth driven by data center and client/gaming segments.
kpis._validation: Unit corrected from 'Mds $' to 'B$'; name_fr improved for clarity; history values verified against 10-K

kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deduction of cost of goods sold and amortization of acquisition-related intangibles.
kpis.signal: Stable and elevated gross margin despite export control inventory charges.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved to 50.0% in 2025 from 49.3% in 2024, primarily due to favorable product mix, partially offset by approximately $440 million of net inventory and related charges associated with U.S. government export controls on AMD Instinct MI308 Data Center GPU products.
kpis._validation: Value corrected to 50.0 for precision; history corrected based on 10-K financials (gross profit / revenue); description clarified with export control impact

kpis.explanation: R&D spending as a percentage of net revenue, reflecting investment in AI and new product development.
kpis.signal: Significant R&D investment for AI advancement and next-generation products.
kpis.description: R&D expenses reached $8.091 billion in 2025, representing 23.4% of net revenue, compared to $6.456 billion or 25.0% in 2024, reflecting disciplined investment in AI and product roadmaps.
kpis._validation: Description revised: R&D intensity decreased despite absolute investment increase, reflecting revenue growth outpacing R&D spending

kpis.explanation: Ratio of capital expenditures to net revenue, reflecting moderate capex requirements of fabless business model.
kpis.signal: Moderate capex reflecting fabless business model with outsourced manufacturing.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures totaled $974 million in 2025, representing 2.8% of net revenue, compared to $645 million or 2.5% in 2024, supporting capacity expansion and infrastructure investments.
kpis._validation: YoY corrected from +0.6 pts to +0.3 pts based on actual calculation (2.8% - 2.5%); description enhanced with actual capex amounts

kpis.explanation: Number of days of inventory on hand for finished goods and components.
kpis.signal: Inventory buildup reflecting demand preparation and export control impacts.
kpis.description: Inventory days increased to 102 days in 2025 from 90 days in 2024, reflecting a buildup related to anticipated AI demand and impact of U.S. export control charges on MI308 products.
kpis._validation: Description refined to clarify both demand preparation and export control contribution to inventory increase

kpis._added_by_iterative_refinement: Aucune mention explicite du volume de wafers traités n'apparaît dans le 10-K fourni.
Aucune mention du taux de rendement de production (yield) n'apparaît dans le 10-K fourni.

kpis.yoy: Croissance implicite via demande forte pour nœuds avancés (5th gen EPYC, MI350)
kpis._added_by_iterative_refinement: Data Center net revenue of $16.6 billion increased by 32% compared to $12.6 billion in 2024, primarily driven by strong demand for our 5th generation AMD EPYC processors and AMD Instinct MI350 Series
Aucune mention des délais de livraison (lead time) n'apparaît dans le 10-K fourni.

stories_kpis.explanation: Revenue from Ryzen processors, Radeon GPUs and semi-custom SoCs for gaming consoles and PCs.
stories_kpis.signal: Major rebound in gaming and PC markets.
stories_kpis.description: The Client and Gaming segment revenue increased to $14.6 billion in 2025 from $9.6 billion in 2024, driven by strong demand for AMD Ryzen processors, Radeon 9000 Series GPUs, and semi-custom SoCs for game consoles.
stories_kpis._validation: Unit corrected from 'Mds $' to 'B$'; description aligned with 10-K MD&A language

stories_kpis.explanation: Revenue from embedded processors for industrial and networking applications.
stories_kpis.signal: Slight decline due to mixed demand across end markets.
stories_kpis.description: Embedded segment revenue declined 3% to $3.5 billion in 2025 from $3.6 billion in 2024, as certain end market demand remained mixed across industrial and networking verticals.
stories_kpis._validation: Unit corrected from 'Mds $' to 'B$'; description refined to reflect 10-K wording

ai_positioning.summary: AMD positions itself as a leader in AI with a comprehensive vertical strategy encompassing hardware, software, and strategic partnerships. Through its Instinct GPU lineup, ROCm software ecosystem, and major agreements with OpenAI and Meta, AMD is accelerating penetration into the generative AI market.
evidence: Launch of AMD Instinct MI350 Series and MI450 Series GPUs dedicated to AI workloads with annual cadence
Strategic partnership with OpenAI: 6 GW GPU deployment agreement with MI450 series as first deployment, warrant for 160M shares at $0.01

Acquisition of ZT Systems for AI infrastructure design capabilities and related technology assets; software ecosystem expansion through targeted acquisitions in compiler, machine learning, photonics, and AI inference
ROCm software stack optimization for generative AI workloads with expanded framework support
ai_positioning._validation: Evidence expanded with specific details from 10-K; warrant structure clarified with exercise price and milestone conditions

corrections: Unit standardization: Converted all 'Mds $' to 'B$' (billions USD) across 9 revenue KPIs for consistency
Gross Margin: History values corrected based on 10-K financials (46.1%, 49.3%, 50.0% calculated as gross profit/revenue)
Capex Intensity YoY: Corrected from +0.6 pts to +0.3 pts (2.8% - 2.5% = +0.3)
R&D Intensity: Clarified that intensity decreased despite absolute R&D spending increase, due to 34% revenue growth
Description improvements: Enhanced clarity on export control impact, inventory buildup drivers, and segment-specific dynamics
Tagline: Updated from generic to data-center and AI-focused positioning
HPC/Cloud KPI: Clarified relationship to Data Center segment and removed duplication concerns
AI Positioning evidence: Expanded with specific partnership terms, acquisition details, and ROCm capabilities from 10-K MD&A
All values verified against 10-K consolidated financial statements for fiscal year ended December 27, 2025
_validation.hallucinogen_detection: No fabricated values detected. All revenue figures, margins, and metrics verified against source 10-K financial statements and MD&A disclosure.
_validation.data_quality_score: High - all KPIs sourced and validated against primary 10-K filing
